page.layout: One page of running text, set in full width in italic. Two marginal notes in the right margin, one beside the middle lines and one beside the lower lines. Handwritten annotations in the margins are not transcribed. Signature at the foot.

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations (including "Oratio Aquensis", the underlining, and the pen notes at the lower right) are not transcribed. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "feviantur" (line break in "oblationes fe / viantur"), "nihil ut" (the word after "nihil" looks like "vtî"), "psequamur" (the abbreviated initial), "cisque" (possibly "eisque"). "Senatuscōs.borrendum" is read as printed. The printed word "hodie" appears to be set with an h that looks like b; read as "hodie".
